analysis.headline: Google positions new smart glasses as more private than Meta's
analysis.summary: Google is marketing its new smart glasses around privacy, explicitly contrasting them with Meta's glasses, which have drawn criticism and the nickname “pervert glasses” over privacy concerns. Coverage describes Google's privacy messaging as attention-seeking, while noting that some of the underlying policies are genuinely good.
